apt.Chinese:
用法：apt [子命令] [软件包...]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：Debian/Ubuntu 系包管理器（apt-get 的友好前端，带进度条与彩色输出）。
常用子命令：
  update / upgrade   更新索引 / 升级已装包
  full-upgrade       升级并处理依赖变更
  install / remove   安装 / 卸载
  purge              卸载并清除配置
  search / show      搜索 / 查看详情
  autoremove         清理不再需要的依赖
典型示例：
  sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y curl   → 更新并安装
  apt search editor                              → 搜索软件包
  apt show nginx                                 → 查看包详情
  sudo apt autoremove --purge                    → 清理无用依赖与配置
进阶技巧：
  • 仅升级单个包：sudo apt install --only-upgrade nginx
  • 查看可升级列表：apt list --upgradable
  • 清理缓存：sudo apt clean
注意事项：
  • 脚本中建议用 apt-get（输出更稳定、无进度条）
相关命令：apt-get、apt-cache、dpkg、pkg
适配系统：仅 Debian/Ubuntu 系 Linux
apt.English:
Usage: apt [subcommand] [package...] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Debian/Ubuntu package manager (friendly front-end to apt-get with progress and colors).
Common subcommands:
  update / upgrade   Refresh index / upgrade installed
  full-upgrade       Upgrade handling dependency changes
  install / remove   Install / remove
  purge              Remove including config
  search / show      Search / package details
  autoremove         Remove unneeded dependencies
Examples:
  sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y curl   -> Update and install
  apt search editor                              -> Search packages
  apt show nginx                                 -> Package details
  sudo apt autoremove --purge                    -> Clean deps and configs
Tips:
  • Upgrade one package: sudo apt install --only-upgrade nginx
  • List upgradable: apt list --upgradable
  • Clear cache: sudo apt clean
Notes:
  • Prefer apt-get in scripts (stable output, no progress bar)
Related: apt-get, apt-cache, dpkg, pkg
Compatible systems: Debian/Ubuntu-based Linux only

apt-get.Chinese:
用法：apt-get [选项] 子命令 [软件包...]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：Debian/Ubuntu 系经典包管理命令，输出稳定，最适合脚本与自动化。
常用子命令：
  update / upgrade    更新索引 / 升级
  dist-upgrade        发行版级升级（可增删依赖）
  install / remove    安装 / 卸载
  purge               卸载并清配置
  autoclean / clean   清理旧包缓存
常用选项：
  -y          自动确认
  --no-install-recommends  不装推荐包（更精简）
  -f          修复损坏依赖
  --dry-run   预演
典型示例：
  apt-get update && apt-get install -y nginx   → 非交互安装
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y git  → 精简安装
  apt-get -f install                            → 修复依赖
  apt-get --dry-run remove nginx                → 预演卸载
进阶技巧：
  • Dockerfile 中推荐：apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pkg && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
  • 检查更新：apt-get -s upgrade
注意事项：
  • 需 root（或 sudo）；update 失败常因源不可达或密钥过期
相关命令：apt、apt-cache、dpkg、pkg
适配系统：仅 Debian/Ubuntu 系 Linux
apt-get.English:
Usage: apt-get [option] subcommand [package...] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Classic Debian/Ubuntu package manager with stable output, ideal for scripts and automation.
Common subcommands:
  update / upgrade    Refresh index / upgrade
  dist-upgrade        Distro-level upgrade (may add/remove deps)
  install / remove    Install / remove
  purge               Remove including config
  autoclean / clean   Clear package cache
Common options:
  -y          Assume yes
  --no-install-recommends  Skip recommended packages
  -f          Fix broken dependencies
  --dry-run   Simulate
Examples:
  apt-get update && apt-get install -y nginx   -> Non-interactive install
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y git  -> Minimal install
  apt-get -f install                            -> Fix dependencies
  apt-get --dry-run remove nginx                -> Simulate removal
Tips:
  • Dockerfile: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pkg && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
  • Check upgrades: apt-get -s upgrade
Notes:
  • Needs root/sudo; update failures are usually mirror or key issues
Related: apt, apt-cache, dpkg, pkg
Compatible systems: Debian/Ubuntu-based Linux only

apt-cache.Chinese:
用法：apt-cache [子命令] [软件包]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：查询 APT 包缓存与元数据（不安装，只看信息）。
常用子命令：
  search          按关键字搜索包
  show            显示包详情（版本/依赖/描述）
  policy          查看候选版本与来源仓库
  depends         查看依赖
  rdepends        查看反向依赖（谁依赖它）
  pkgnames        列出所有包名
典型示例：
  apt-cache search editor          → 搜索编辑器相关包
  apt-cache show nginx             → 查看包详情
  apt-cache policy nginx           → 查看可用版本
  apt-cache rdepends libssl3       → 谁依赖它
进阶技巧：
  • 找文件属于哪个包：apt-file search /usr/bin/xxx（需装 apt-file）
  • 查看未安装包的依赖树：apt-cache depends --recurse pkg
注意事项：
  • 数据来自本地索引，先 apt update 才能看到最新包
相关命令：apt、apt-get、dpkg
适配系统：仅 Debian/Ubuntu 系 Linux
apt-cache.English:
Usage: apt-cache [subcommand] [package] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Query the APT package cache and metadata (no installation).
Common subcommands:
  search          Search packages by keyword
  show            Package details (version/deps/description)
  policy          Candidate version and origin
  depends         Dependencies
  rdepends        Reverse dependencies
  pkgnames        List all package names
Examples:
  apt-cache search editor          -> Search editor packages
  apt-cache show nginx             -> Package details
  apt-cache policy nginx           -> Available versions
  apt-cache rdepends libssl3       -> Who depends on it
Tips:
  • Which package owns a file: apt-file search /usr/bin/xxx
  • Dependency tree: apt-cache depends --recurse pkg
Notes:
  • Uses the local index; run apt update first
Related: apt, apt-get, dpkg
Compatible systems: Debian/Ubuntu-based Linux only

dpkg.Chinese:
用法：dpkg [选项] 动作（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：Debian 底层包工具，直接操作 .deb 文件（不解决依赖）。
常用选项：
  -i FILE     安装本地 deb
  -r / -P     卸载 / 卸载并清配置
  -l [PATTERN] 列出已安装包
  -L PKG      列出包内文件
  -S FILE     查询文件属于哪个包
  --configure PKG  重新配置包
  -s PKG      包状态
典型示例：
  sudo dpkg -i app.deb             → 安装本地 deb
  dpkg -L nginx                    → 查看该包安装了哪些文件
  dpkg -S /usr/bin/ls              → 文件归属
  sudo dpkg --configure -a         → 修复未完成配置
  sudo apt -f install              → 修复 dpkg 依赖问题
进阶技巧：
  • dpkg -i 报依赖错误时用 apt -f install 补齐依赖
  • 提取 deb 内容不解包：dpkg -x app.deb dir/
注意事项：
  • dpkg 不做依赖解析；批量安装优先用 apt
相关命令：apt、apt-get、apt-cache
适配系统：仅 Debian/Ubuntu 系 Linux
dpkg.English:
Usage: dpkg [option] action (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Low-level Debian package tool working directly with .deb files (no dependency resolution).
Common options:
  -i FILE     Install a local deb
  -r / -P     Remove / purge
  -l [PATTERN] List installed packages
  -L PKG      Files installed by a package
  -S FILE     Which package owns a file
  --configure PKG  Reconfigure
  -s PKG      Package status
Examples:
  sudo dpkg -i app.deb             -> Install a local deb
  dpkg -L nginx                    -> List installed files
  dpkg -S /usr/bin/ls              -> File ownership
  sudo dpkg --configure -a         -> Fix pending configuration
  sudo apt -f install              -> Fix dependency issues
Tips:
  • If dpkg -i reports missing deps, run apt -f install
  • Extract a deb: dpkg -x app.deb dir/
Notes:
  • dpkg does not resolve dependencies; prefer apt for batch installs
Related: apt, apt-get, apt-cache
Compatible systems: Debian/Ubuntu-based Linux only

pkg.Chinese:
用法：pkg [子命令] [软件包...]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：Termux 包管理器（apt 的封装，路径与仓库已为 Termux 适配）。
常用子命令：
  install / uninstall   安装 / 卸载
  update / upgrade      更新索引 / 升级
  search                搜索包
  show                  包详情
  list-installed        列出已安装
  list-all              列出仓库全部包
  files PKG             查看包内文件
典型示例：
  pkg update && pkg upgrade        → 更新并升级
  pkg install -y nmap              → 安装 nmap
  pkg search editor                → 搜索
  pkg files python                 → 查看包内容
进阶技巧：
  • 与 apt 等价：pkg install = apt install，但会自动处理 Termux 前缀
  • 换源加速：termux-change-repo 选择国内镜像
注意事项：
  • 仅适用于 Termux；不要在普通 Linux 上使用 pkg
相关命令：apt、apt-get、termux-change-repo
适配系统：仅 Termux
pkg.English:
Usage: pkg [subcommand] [package...] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Termux package manager (apt wrapper tuned for Termux paths and repos).
Common subcommands:
  install / uninstall   Install / remove
  update / upgrade      Refresh index / upgrade
  search                Search packages
  show                  Package details
  list-installed        List installed
  list-all              List all repo packages
  files PKG             Files in a package
Examples:
  pkg update && pkg upgrade        -> Update and upgrade
  pkg install -y nmap              -> Install nmap
  pkg search editor                -> Search
  pkg files python                 -> Inspect package contents
Tips:
  • Equivalent to apt but Termux-aware (handles the prefix)
  • Faster mirrors: termux-change-repo
Notes:
  • Termux only; do not use pkg on regular Linux
Related: apt, apt-get, termux-change-repo
Compatible systems: Termux only

yum.Chinese:
用法：yum [选项] 子命令 [软件包...]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：RHEL/CentOS 7 及更早版本的包管理器（dnf 的前身）。
常用子命令：
  install / remove    安装 / 卸载
  update              升级
  search / info       搜索 / 详情
  list                列出包
  provides FILE       查询文件由哪个包提供
  clean all           清理缓存
常用选项：
  -y          自动确认
  --enablerepo/--disablerepo  启用/禁用仓库
典型示例：
  sudo yum install -y httpd        → 安装并确认
  yum info nginx                   → 查看详情
  yum provides /usr/bin/ls         → 文件归属
  sudo yum update -y               → 全量升级
进阶技巧：
  • 只做安全检查：yum check-update
  • 历史回滚：yum history undo N
注意事项：
  • 新系统请用 dnf（yum 在新版中通常是 dnf 的软链）
相关命令：dnf、rpm、apt
适配系统：仅 RHEL/CentOS 系 Linux
yum.English:
Usage: yum [option] subcommand [package...] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Package manager for RHEL/CentOS 7 and older (predecessor of dnf).
Common subcommands:
  install / remove    Install / remove
  update              Upgrade
  search / info       Search / details
  list                List packages
  provides FILE       Which package provides a file
  clean all           Clear cache
Common options:
  -y          Assume yes
  --enablerepo/--disablerepo  Enable/disable repos
Examples:
  sudo yum install -y httpd        -> Install with confirmation
  yum info nginx                   -> Details
  yum provides /usr/bin/ls         -> File ownership
  sudo yum update -y               -> Full upgrade
Tips:
  • Check only: yum check-update
  • Roll back: yum history undo N
Notes:
  • Prefer dnf on newer systems (yum is often a dnf symlink)
Related: dnf, rpm, apt
Compatible systems: RHEL/CentOS-based Linux only

dnf.Chinese:
用法：dnf [选项] 子命令 [软件包...]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：Fedora/RHEL 8+ 的新一代包管理器（yum 的继任者，依赖解析更快）。
常用子命令：
  install / remove    安装 / 卸载
  upgrade             升级（可 dnf upgrade --refresh）
  search / info       搜索 / 详情
  list                列出包
  provides FILE       文件归属查询
  history             操作历史（可 undo）
  group install       安装软件组
常用选项：
  -y          自动确认
  --refresh   强制刷新元数据
典型示例：
  sudo dnf install -y git          → 安装 git
  dnf search editor                → 搜索
  sudo dnf upgrade --refresh       → 刷新并升级
  sudo dnf history undo 5          → 回滚第 5 次操作
进阶技巧：
  • 清理缓存：sudo dnf clean all
  • 查看依赖树：dnf repoquery --tree
注意事项：
  • 需 root；某些操作会重新下载大量元数据，注意网络
相关命令：yum、rpm、apt
适配系统：仅 Fedora/RHEL 8+ Linux
dnf.English:
Usage: dnf [option] subcommand [package...] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Next-gen package manager for Fedora/RHEL 8+ (yum successor with faster dependency resolution).
Common subcommands:
  install / remove    Install / remove
  upgrade             Upgrade (dnf upgrade --refresh)
  search / info       Search / details
  list                List packages
  provides FILE       File ownership
  history             Transaction history (undo)
  group install       Install a group
Common options:
  -y          Assume yes
  --refresh   Force metadata refresh
Examples:
  sudo dnf install -y git          -> Install git
  dnf search editor                -> Search
  sudo dnf upgrade --refresh       -> Refresh and upgrade
  sudo dnf history undo 5          -> Undo transaction 5
Tips:
  • Clear cache: sudo dnf clean all
  • Dependency tree: dnf repoquery --tree
Notes:
  • Needs root; some operations re-download lots of metadata
Related: yum, rpm, apt
Compatible systems: Fedora/RHEL 8+ only

rpm.Chinese:
用法：rpm [选项] [软件包]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：RPM 底层包工具，直接操作 .rpm（不做依赖解析）。
常用选项：
  -ivh FILE    安装并显示进度
  -Uvh FILE    升级安装
  -e PKG       卸载
  -qa          列出所有已安装包
  -ql PKG      列出包内文件
  -qf FILE     查询文件所属包
  -qR PKG      查看依赖
  -V PKG       校验包完整性
典型示例：
  sudo rpm -ivh app.rpm            → 安装 RPM
  rpm -qa | grep nginx             → 是否已安装
  rpm -qf /usr/bin/ls              → 文件归属
  rpm -V nginx                     → 校验文件是否被改
进阶技巧：
  • 查询未安装包内容：rpm -qlp app.rpm
  • 依赖错误时用 dnf/yum 安装，它们会自动解析
注意事项：
  • rpm 不解决依赖，直接安装失败时改用 dnf install ./app.rpm
相关命令：dnf、yum、apt
适配系统：仅 RHEL/CentOS/Fedora 系 Linux
rpm.English:
Usage: rpm [option] [package] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Low-level RPM tool operating on .rpm files (no dependency resolution).
Common options:
  -ivh FILE    Install with progress
  -Uvh FILE    Upgrade
  -e PKG       Erase
  -qa          List installed
  -ql PKG      Files in a package
  -qf FILE     Which package owns a file
  -qR PKG      Dependencies
  -V PKG       Verify integrity
Examples:
  sudo rpm -ivh app.rpm            -> Install an RPM
  rpm -qa | grep nginx             -> Is it installed
  rpm -qf /usr/bin/ls              -> File ownership
  rpm -V nginx                     -> Verify files
Tips:
  • Inspect an uninstalled rpm: rpm -qlp app.rpm
  • On dependency errors use dnf/yum instead
Notes:
  • rpm does not resolve dependencies; use dnf install ./app.rpm
Related: dnf, yum, apt
Compatible systems: RHEL/CentOS/Fedora only

pacman.Chinese:
用法：pacman [选项] [软件包]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：Arch Linux 包管理器，选项以“操作+修饰”组合而成。
常用选项：
  -S PKG      安装
  -Sy         仅同步索引
  -Syu        同步索引并全系统升级（最常用）
  -Ss KW     搜索
  -Si PKG     查看详情
  -R PKG      卸载
  -Rs PKG     卸载并移除未用依赖
  -Q          查询已安装
  -Ql PKG     列出包内文件
  -Sc         清理缓存
典型示例：
  sudo pacman -Syu                 → 同步并升级全系统
  sudo pacman -S nginx             → 安装
  pacman -Ss editor                → 搜索
  sudo pacman -Rs nginx            → 卸载并清依赖
进阶技巧：
  • 切勿只 -Sy 而不 -u（部分升级会导致依赖破损）
  • 文件归属：pacman -Qo /usr/bin/ls
注意事项：
  • Arch 滚动更新，建议定期 -Syu 并阅读新闻
相关命令：yay、paru、apt、dnf
适配系统：仅 Arch Linux
pacman.English:
Usage: pacman [option] [package] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Arch Linux package manager with operation+modifier style options.
Common options:
  -S PKG      Install
  -Sy         Sync index only
  -Syu        Sync and full system upgrade (most used)
  -Ss KW     Search
  -Si PKG     Details
  -R PKG      Remove
  -Rs PKG     Remove with unused deps
  -Q          Query installed
  -Ql PKG     Files in a package
  -Sc         Clear cache
Examples:
  sudo pacman -Syu                 -> Sync and upgrade everything
  sudo pacman -S nginx             -> Install
  pacman -Ss editor                -> Search
  sudo pacman -Rs nginx            -> Remove with deps
Tips:
  • Never -Sy without -u (partial upgrades break dependencies)
  • File ownership: pacman -Qo /usr/bin/ls
Notes:
  • Arch is rolling-release; upgrade regularly and read the news
Related: yay, paru, apt, dnf
Compatible systems: Arch Linux only

brew.Chinese:
用法：brew [子命令] [软件包]（Linux/Termux 专属）
功能：Homebrew 包管理器（macOS/Linux），用户态安装，无需 root。
常用子命令：
  install / uninstall  安装 / 卸载
  update               更新 Homebrew 自身与公式
  upgrade              升级已装包
  search / info        搜索 / 详情
  list                 已安装列表
  services             管理后台服务（start/stop）
  doctor               环境体检
常用选项：
  --cask      安装图形应用（macOS）
  -g          全局（在 Linux 上等价于默认）
典型示例：
  brew install wget                → 安装 wget
  brew update && brew upgrade      → 更新并升级
  brew services start postgresql   → 启动服务
  brew doctor                      → 排查环境问题
进阶技巧：
  • 导出/恢复：brew bundle dump / brew bundle
  • 清理旧版本：brew cleanup
注意事项：
  • 无需 sudo；权限问题通常是目录属主不对（brew doctor 会提示）
相关命令：apt、pkg、port
适配系统：macOS / Linux（Windows 用 WSL）
brew.English:
Usage: brew [subcommand] [package] (Linux/Termux only)
Function: Homebrew package manager (macOS/Linux) with user-level installs, no root required.
Common subcommands:
  install / uninstall  Install / remove
  update               Update Homebrew and formulae
  upgrade              Upgrade installed
  search / info        Search / details
  list                 Installed list
  services             Manage background services (start/stop)
  doctor               Environment checkup
Common options:
  --cask      Install GUI apps (macOS)
  -g          Global (default on Linux)
Examples:
  brew install wget                -> Install wget
  brew update && brew upgrade      -> Update and upgrade
  brew services start postgresql   -> Start a service
  brew doctor                      -> Diagnose the environment
Tips:
  • Export/restore: brew bundle dump / brew bundle
  • Clean old versions: brew cleanup
Notes:
  • No sudo needed; permission issues are usually directory ownership (brew doctor tells you)
Related: apt, pkg, port
Compatible systems: macOS / Linux (Windows via WSL)
